title: ICU neurological observation review

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, consciousness, oxygen saturation, skin signs, urine output, fever or rigors, and examination for the suspected infection source.
user_facing_items.population: People aged 16 years and over with suspected sepsis, excluding people who are or have recently been pregnant.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, ambulance, acute hospital, and emergency assessment settings.
restrictions: Exact for suspected sepsis recognition and assessment in non-pregnant people aged 16 years and over; partial for a broad fever or suspected-infection workflow and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports entered consciousness and acute observations for ICU neurological-observation review; it does not generate a clinical decision.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports confusion, respiratory compromise, hypotension, tachycardia, oliguria, temperature abnormality, non-blanching or mottled skin, and immunosuppression as assessed risk features.
